import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import z3, analyze, infer, genbig
checks = []
orig = infer._Program.model
def w(self, extra=()):
    t0 = time.process_time(); r = orig(self, extra); dt = time.process_time()-t0
    checks.append((dt, self._age, str(extra[0]).replace(chr(10),' ')[:70] if extra else 'base'))
    return r
infer._Program.model = w
x = genbig.gen(11, 'wide')
t0 = time.process_time()
got = analyze.process_line(json.dumps(x, separators=(',', ':')).encode())
print('total %.1fs checks=%d status=%s k=%s' % (time.process_time()-t0, len(checks), got.get('status'), got.get('min_faults')))
s = sorted(checks, key=lambda r: -r[0])
for dt, age, e in s[:8]:
    print('  %.3fs age=%d %s' % (dt, age, e))
print('checks>50ms: %d, their sum %.1fs' % (sum(1 for c in checks if c[0]>0.05), sum(c[0] for c in checks if c[0]>0.05)))
"
